assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor.
The symptoms are of a non-sustained nature.
There is a need for extended rhythm correlation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period.
CPT 93229 is the code for mobile cardiac telemetry.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The provider may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of this notice.
